import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXNODES = 2020;
    static final int INF = 3010;

    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAXNODES];
    static int[] dist_to_sink = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] partner = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[][] ir = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] sc = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] pc = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid_s = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid_p = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dd = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static List<Integer>[][] src_nodes = new List[MAXN][MAXN];
    static List<Integer>[][] dst_nodes = new List[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void connect(int u, int v) {
        adj[u].add(v);
        adj[v].add(u);
    }

    static int src_cnt, dst_cnt;

    static boolean bfs_layered() {
        Deque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= src_cnt; ++i) {
            if (partner[i] == 0) {
                dist_to_sink[i] = 0;
                q.addLast(i);
            } else {
                dist_to_sink[i] = INF;
            }
        }
        dist_to_sink[0] = INF;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.pollFirst();
            if (dist_to_sink[u] < dist_to_sink[0]) {
                for (int v_node : adj[u]) {
                    int v = partner[v_node];
                    if (dist_to_sink[v] > dist_to_sink[u] + 1) {
                        dist_to_sink[v] = dist_to_sink[u] + 1;
                        q.addLast(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_to_sink[0] != INF;
    }

    static boolean dfs_augment(int u) {
        if (u == 0) return true;
        for (int v_node : adj[u]) {
            int v = partner[v_node];
            if (dist_to_sink[v] == dist_to_sink[u] + 1) {
                if (dfs_augment(v)) {
                    partner[u] = v_node;
                    partner[v_node] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int max_matching() {
        int match_count = 0;
        while (bfs_layered()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= src_cnt; ++i) {
                if (partner[i] == 0) {
                    match_count += dfs_augment(i) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return match_count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODES; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                src_nodes[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                dst_nodes[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ir[i], t);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid_s[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid_p[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        
        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        src_cnt = 1;
        dst_cnt = 1000;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = grid_s[i][j];
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (c == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    sc[i][j] = c - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; ++k) {
                        src_nodes[i][j].add(src_cnt++);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = grid_p[i][j];
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    pc[i][j] = c - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; ++k) {
                        dst_nodes[i][j].add(dst_cnt++);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && 
                    ir[nx][ny] > ir[x][y] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sc[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++)
                        for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++)
                            dd[x][y] = 100000;
                    Deque<int[]> dq = new ArrayDeque<>();
                    dd[i][j] = 0;
                    dq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!dq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = dq.pollFirst();
                        int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
                        for (int src_id : src_nodes[i][j]) {
                            for (int dst_id : dst_nodes[x][y]) {
                                connect(src_id, dst_id);
                            }
                        }
                        if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) continue;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n &&
                                sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && 
                                dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                                dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                                dq.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_matching());
    }
}
